name: keeps_disconnecting
description: Use when the app keeps losing the adapter, live readings drop out or the connection is unstable: adapter health and recent app errors.
instructions: Call run_skill {"name":"keeps_disconnecting"}: it runs the adapter health check (grade, firmware, voltage, protocol) and, when the error log is present, lists the app's last 10 errors.
Open adapter_health and app_errors to read them; tell adapter and phone problems apart from car problems before suggesting anything about the car.
interpret: A poor adapter grade or a clone firmware explains dropouts on its own: suggest a better adapter.
With the engine running, a module voltage under 13.5 V = not charging; a supply under 11.5 V with the engine off makes many adapters reset.
Many connection errors in the last 24 h with a good adapter grade point to Bluetooth range, the phone's battery saver or a loose OBD socket.
Errors only while cranking are normal: the voltage dip resets many adapters.
